title: Creating list of items
code:
def make_list():
    team_number = int (input ("How many teams in a hackathlon?"))
    teamlist = [0] * team_number
    for i in range(team_number):
        print("How many members in team", i)
        teamlist[i] = int (input ("? "))
    return teamlist

print(make_list())

lines.explanation: Defining the function 'make_list'. Here we do not pass any arguments or parameters to the function

lines.code: team_number = int (input ("How many teams in a hackathlon?"))
lines.explanation: This statement takes in the user input and converts the input to 'int' type
this 'for loop' iterates from 0 to team number - 1, i.e., it iterates through each team

lines.code: print("How many members in team", i)

lines.explanation: This statement takes in the user input to number of members in a team. Note that this is inside the for loop so it will ask for number of members in each team as it iterates through each team
It then returns the list with the numbers of members in each team
